questions.question: What should you do if another car cuts into your gap?
options: Ease off to rebuild a safe gap
Stay close to hold your place
questions.explanation: Drop back calmly so you have room to stop safely.

questions.question: Why is tailgating risky in town traffic?
options: You have less time to react and stop
questions.explanation: Leaving space lets you see hazards ahead and brake smoothly.
